title: Permeabilization of Adhered Cells Using an Inert Gas Jet
protocol: Attach the mass flow controller (MKS M100B Mass-Flo Controller) to the helium gas line.
Control the mass flow controller using an input voltage between 0 and 5 V through a control loop in the LabView program.
Interface the computer with the mass flow controller via a NI USB-6009 data acquisition device.
Power the mass flow controller with a 12 V power supply.
Use two positioning linear slides to control the movement of the 6-well plate, one for each direction.
Couple each linear slide with a MA15-series Velmex Unislide Assembly and stepping motor.
Control both assemblies with a single Velmex VXM Stepping Motor Controller.
Manually jog each motor or accept external serial commands through the controller to define movement patterns.
Program specific torch speed and path dimensions into the LabView program for automated control.
Center the platform by ensuring each motor stage carriage is not near either end.
Run the program once without cells if it is the first run of the day.
Remove the capillary from the holder and zero the height dial.
Place a 6-well plate on the platform.
Replace and lower the gas jet capillary to the bottom of the well until it touches the cover slip.
Secure the capillary in the holder.
Raise the capillary by 3 mm using the height dial.
Mark this height on the base of the capillary.
Raise the capillary to a safe height.
Remove the 6-well plate.
Culture an adherent cell line to confluence on glass cover slips in a 6-well plate using standard culturing techniques.
Seed 6-well plates with HeLa cells at a density of 2 x 10^5 cells per well and incubate for 48 hours before treatment.
Prepare the appropriate volume of solution containing the desired vector, such as hrGFPII-1 or green fluorescent dextran.
For hrGFPII-1, use a concentration of 50 ng/μl in 1x PBS to achieve strong fluorescence in HeLa cells 24 hours post-transfection.
Remove cell culture media from well.
Rinse well three times with 1x PBS.
Pipette 1,370 μl of vector solution into well.
Place the well containing the vector solution in the center of the platform.
Lower the gas jet nozzle to a height of 3 mm above the slide.
Set helium flow rate in LabView program and select desired movement pattern.
Select "Run" when ready to begin permeabilization protocol.
Wait approximately 30 seconds after the platform has stopped before removing the vector solution.
Wash well three times with 1x PBS.
Fill well with fresh culture media.
Repeat steps for desired number of experiments.
Include control samples by filling wells with vector solution without running gas jet over them.
Leave solution in control wells for approximately 1 minute before proceeding to wash and refill steps.
Return 6-well plate to incubator for 24 hours if running an hrGFP transfection experiment.
Return 6-well plate to incubator for 15 minutes if running a dextran permeabilization experiment.
Counterstain cells with appropriate live/dead stain immediately before imaging, if desired.
Image cells using the appropriate microscope to investigate transfection or permeabilization efficacy.
